name: Switzerland Farm Safety MCP
description: Enables querying of Swiss farm workplace safety regulations including BUL/SPAA rules, Suva occupational requirements, EKAS standards, and Agriss accident statistics. Provides tools for risk assessments, machinery safety compliance, chemical exposure limits, young worker protections, and accident reporting guidelines.
